group.label: Abyss
group.evidence: GroupName prefix Abyss_Reshanta_*; WorldMapMapList category Abyss lists ids 20 and 23 (id 22 grouped by name)

world_bounds.units: client world units; z is not bounded
world_bounds.derivation: min = StartWorldLocation; max = min + SectorWorldSize * tile count

tiles.row_axis: file Y index = image row, row 0 at the top

coordinate_transform.world_to_pixel: px = (wx - start_x) / sector_world_size * tile_px ; py = (wy - start_y) / sector_world_size * tile_px
coordinate_transform.pixel_origin: top-left of the stitched tile canvas; x right, y down
coordinate_transform.note: The legacy json/*.json pixel fields (8192 - raw) are a 180-degree-rotated extraction bug and are NOT used by this package.
